name: bld_nilpotent_rank_bound
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (k : ℕ) (h : A ^ k = 0) : k * Matrix.rank A ≤ (k - 1) * Fintype.card ι
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (k : ℕ) (h : A ^ k = 0), k * Matrix.rank A ≤ (k - 1) * Fintype.card ι
informal: Uses Mathlib2.gen_lin_sylvester_rank_rect: by induction on j, j * rank A ≤ (j-1) * n + rank (A^j) (Sylvester applied to A^j and A); at j = k the last term vanishes. Special case k = 2: A^2 = 0 implies 2 rank A ≤ n.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (k : ℕ), A ^ k = 0 → k * A.rank ≤ (k - 1) * Fintype.card ι
